text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
How did you spend your day off? I
protected the
peace in the town with
Biko!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Collecting trash, patrolling the area...
We even
put on a superhero
performance in the park!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What do you think? A fantastically
fulfilling day off for a class
representative and model student,
if I do
say so myself!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems Sakura Bakushin O was able to
enjoy her
day off in her own unique way.
